Title: Decisions only
Prompt: From these notes, list decisions. If a point was discussed but not decided, put it under 'not decided'. Do not add decisions.

Title: Owners
Prompt: Assign owners only where the notes name a person. Otherwise write 'owner not named'.

Title: Short send
Prompt: Write the follow-up email in under 150 words using only the decisions and owners list. No new topics.

Title: Risks mentioned
Prompt: List worries that were said in the meeting. Do not solve them.
Check: Each worry is from the notes.

Title: Agenda for next time
Prompt: Turn 'not decided' items into an agenda of five items or fewer.
Check: The agenda does not add new work.

Title: Absent person
Prompt: Write a five-line brief for the person who was absent. No jokes about them.
Check: The brief is usable without the transcript.
